user.title: Add and test inverter
user.description: Enter the inverter/WiNet IP, TCP port and Modbus unit ID. Continuing identifies the device, reads its backup SOC, writes the same value once and reads it back. Results are displayed before saving. For systems with an iHomeManager use the inverter endpoint; the native iHomeManager backup SOC path is unsupported.

test_result.title: Communication test result
test_result.description:
{report}

Continue to categories on success, or return to connection settings on failure. A failed test prevents saving. Nothing has been saved yet.

categories.title: Manage categories
categories.description:
{overview}

Months belong exclusively to one category. Unassigned months remain unmanaged, including during weather warnings. Free months by editing or deleting an existing category to add a new one.

category.title: Edit category
category.description: Only free months and months belonging to this category are selectable. Warning reserve applies at current DWD levels 2–4. {details}

remove.title: Select category to delete
remove.description: Its months become available. Changes are committed only when saved.

error.invalid_category: Check the category name, months and SOC values.
